title: Day after US halts foreign aid, Zelenskyy says military aid to Ukraine continues
description: The future of US support to Ukraine remains a focal point as President Donald Trump begins his second term. Trump has repeatedly claimed that Russia’s invasion would not have occurred if he had been in office.

title: Putin says Russia 'ready for negotiations' with Donald Trump on Ukraine
description: Russian President Vladimir Putin said he is "ready for negotiations" with U.S. President Donald Trump about how to end the war in Ukraine.

description: Officials of the MEA and the Ministry of Home Affairs are busy making preparations to ensure a smooth experience for the diplomats

title: US President Donald Trump asks OPEC to cut oil prices, argues it'll stop Russia-Ukraine war
description: The US president had earlier said Russian President Vladimir Putin 'should make a deal' with Ukraine while asserting that they would meet as soon as they can.

title: Trump Urges OPEC to Slash Oil Prices to Halt Ukraine War
description: US President Donald Trump has called on OPEC to reduce oil prices, asserting that doing so could end the Russia-Ukraine conflict. He accused OPEC+ of exacerbating the war and suggested lowering prices as a quick solution. Trump further urged Russian President Putin to negotiate peace.

title: Ukraine war briefing: Putin aiming to ‘manipulate’ Trump, Zelenskyy warns
description: Ukrainian president issues warning after Russia’s leader said he was ‘ready for negotiations’ with US counterpart on the war. What we know on day 1,067

title: Trump Urges OPEC+ to Slash Oil Prices Amid Russia-Ukraine Conflict
description: President Donald Trump calls on OPEC+ to reduce oil prices to compel Russia to end the Ukraine conflict. He believes cutting prices will strain Russia's revenue from oil sales, forcing peace negotiations. However, experts believe achieving such cooperation from OPEC+ nations is challenging.

title: Trump leans in on targeting Russian oil revenue as he tries to fulfill pledge to end Ukraine war
description: WASHINGTON (AP) — President Donald Trump is emphasizing that targeting Russia's oil revenue is the best way to get Moscow to end its nearly three-year war against Ukraine.
